name: W Guangzhou
insider_take: This ultra-modern tower rises 67 floors above Pearl River New Town, offering electrifying skyline views and W's signature bold design in China's manufacturing capital.
whats_special: Located in Guangzhou's gleaming financial district, W Guangzhou features one of the city's highest rooftop bars with panoramic views of the Pearl River. The hotel's striking LED-illuminated exterior makes it a beacon in the skyline, while inside, guests find contemporary Chinese art installations and the brand's signature WET pool deck suspended high above the bustling metropolis.
pro_tip: Visit the WOOBAR during golden hour for Instagram-worthy shots of the Canton Tower and Pearl River, then stay for their signature cocktails featuring local Guangdong ingredients.
dont_miss: The nearby Canton Tower (just 10 minutes away) offers the world's highest Ferris wheel, while the historic Shamian Island provides a charming contrast with its colonial architecture and tree-lined boulevards. For authentic Cantonese cuisine, explore the legendary dim sum houses in the nearby Liwan District.
pros: Prime location in Tianhe CBD with direct metro access
Stunning panoramic city views from upper floors
Contemporary W design with vibrant modern interiors
Excellent dining venues including rooftop bar
cons: Modern design may not appeal to traditional preferences
